provider_caveats.parallel_note: Conversations and judge calls ran 12 at a time, not one after another. Recall, tokens and cost are unaffected. Latency was measured under the benchmark's own load and is not comparable with a one-at-a-time run; for memory read and write latency use scripts/memory_latency.py.

spend.basis: recorded tokens at pricing.yaml list prices; not the provider's invoice

notes: The run was started with 18 conversations at once, was rate limited by the provider (HTTP 429, requests per minute), and was stopped after about 100 seconds. It was resumed with 12 at once and 12 retries per call; every conversation in this bundle ran under that setting. The dropped first attempt's spend is in spend.dropped_usd. The manifest's parallel value and note were corrected by hand from 18 to 12 on 2026-11-16 for that reason.

git.dirty is true because the parallel mode (PARALLEL, src/harness.py, src/bundle.py, src/scoring/rescore.py, src/llm_factory.py, src/config.py) was not yet committed when the run started. It was committed unchanged as 427ae29, apart from a later one-line change that makes a resume record its own PARALLEL value.
